Run this one command with the Bash tool, in the current directory, in the foreground, with a timeout of 600000 milliseconds:

```sh
HACKWIN_CALLER=claude-code hackwin gate $ARGUMENTS
```

Then give the user the output of the command unchanged, and its exit code when it is not 0. Do nothing else: run no other command, change no file, do not change the directory and do not run the command again. `hackwin gate` does all the work, and its output names the next step and the directory to run it in.
